verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev workflows are plain async/await TypeScript functions with no workflow DSL, so conditions and branching are only possible by writing code. triggerAndWait lets a task call a subtask and continue with its result, but nothing shows explicit parallel fan-out or merge, or an ops-friendly visual way to build branches. Community users describe it as the code-in-IDE alternative to GUI tools like n8n, which confirms there is no visual builder. Missing for 10: visual or no-code branch builder for ops users, documented conditional and filter steps, parallel fan-out with merge/join, and hands-on corroboration of branching workflows.
